question: A device of 30 W is connected to a 12 V battery. The current in the device is:
solution:
The correct answer is** __2.5 A__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Electric Power**

 
 
• Electric power is the rate at which an** electric circuit **transfers electrical energy per unit of time in physics.
 
• P stands for power, and it is measured in **watts or one joule per second**, the SI unit of power. Electric generators and electric batteries typically provide** electric power.**
 
• The equation for electric power is as follows**: P=IV**, where V is the potential difference in the circuit and P, is the power and I is the current of electricity.
 
• Power can also be written as** P=I²R and V²/R.​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Calculation**

 
 
• Power,** P= 30W**

 Battery of Voltage, **V= 12V**

 We know, P=IV

 30= I×12

 I= 30/12

 I= 5/2

 **I= 2.5A**
